beats.say: Analysts expect about ten point one billion dollars in revenue. The report lands after the market closes.
Guidance is the company's own forecast. Consensus is the average analyst forecast. Wall Street expects revenue near the middle of Qualcomm's guided range.
Three things to watch. Phones. Cars. And Apple, which is moving to its own modems.
